verdict.rationale: PagerDuty publishes first-party developer docs for a REST API that lets third parties read and change account configuration: users, notification rules, response workflows, on-call lookups and manual incident creation. The docs also cover API versioning via a header, an asynchronous Events API v2 for ingesting events, and v3 webhook subscriptions for callbacks. A community integrator confirms hands-on use of the Events API but reports friction: v1 and v2 keys are incompatible and cannot be told apart. Missing for 10: authentication, rate-limit and endpoint-reference details in the evidence, plus the reported Events API key-version confusion.
